metadata.article_title: Interpretation of words repeated in different parts of will.

article.title: Interpretation of words repeated in different parts of will.
article.content:
86Interpretation of words repeated in different parts of will.

Section 86  ·  Part VI · Chapter VI  ·  page 35 of the Act
If the same words occur in different parts of the same will, they shall be taken to have been used everywhere in the same sense, unless a contrary intention appears.
